description: NPM ERESOLVE conflict between ondajs and remotion due to conflicting zod versions, preventing clean `npm ci`.
remediation: Aligned workspace root zod to ^3.25.0 and synchronized all @remotion/* packages to 4.0.524, allowing valid nested installations.

description: Blueprint defined raw physical paths (sometimes pointing to agent-specific directories or developer-local paths) which break cross-environment portability.
remediation: Enforced Logical Asset IDs in blueprint. materialize_project.py generates media_map.json. Runtime safely resolves logical IDs to relative paths.

description: 04_timings.json, master_plan.md, and 05_blueprint.json lack a unified pipeline-invoked automation script. The canonical producer is the Agent interacting with MCPs and manually generating intermediate JSONs.
remediation: Documented the explicit pipeline boundary. The Agent is formally recognized as the orchestrating producer of these files, while the Python pipeline acts strictly as a mechanical validator/gatekeeper.

description: Missing pytest-asyncio in requirements.txt caused async test suites in fresh venv to execute as sync, causing 15 test failures.
remediation: Added pytest-asyncio to requirements.txt in main repository.

description: scripts/pipeline.py lacked an execution step for scripts/materialize_project.py, leaving media_map.json ungenerated and public assets unmaterialized during pipeline execution.
remediation: Added materialize_project execution stage to scripts/pipeline.py under Blueprint/Asset transition.

description: scripts/materialize_project.py hardcoded check for 01_plan.md instead of supporting canonical master_plan.md.
remediation: Updated materialize_project.py to accept either master_plan.md or legacy 01_plan.md.

description: scripts/render_project.py blocked rendering if status != 'locked' even when running under managed canonical pipeline (is_managed == True), preventing headless execution without manual gate approval bypasses.
remediation: Allowed managed pipeline execution (is_managed == True) to render without requiring manual GUI gate approval.

description: scripts/probe_qc.py and scripts/open_studio.py generated render_props.json without including media_map, causing QC frame rendering and Studio preview to fail asset resolution for Logical Asset IDs.
remediation: Included media_map: safe_load('media_map.json', {}) in projectData for both scripts/probe_qc.py and scripts/open_studio.py.

description: scripts/asset_gate.py expected a direct manifest path argument, while scripts/pipeline.py passes project_id, causing asset_gate to skip manifest validation during canonical pipeline execution.
remediation: Updated asset_gate.py to resolve project_id or project directory to 02_asset_manifest.json.
